name: Bagan
description: Bagan sits on a bend of the Ayeyarwady River in central Myanmar, where thousands of brick temples and pagodas rise from a dry plain. Between the 11th and 13th centuries, the kings of the Pagan Kingdom had more than 10,000 built, and the remains of over 2,300 still stand. Visitors can climb to viewpoints at sunrise and see the spires emerge from the mist, or step inside to find old frescoes and Buddha statues.
